digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow — optionality verification
propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml uses 1 concurrent slot but provides no unique test coverage; the same 9 tests already run in the _build-and-test.yml matrix cells (3.11/3.12/3.13 + macOS) which provide strictly more coverage.

Deleting the import-linter job closes a visibility gap: existing tests (test_ci_workflow_parity.py and check_verify_gate_parity.py) only check caller-level wiring and cannot detect if test files are accidentally excluded from the default suite via markers or paths filters.

A durable collection guard test must assert that test_core_optionality.py and test_optional.py collect exactly 9 items under the default suite selection (-m 'not integration and not external'), and must fail if future edits add markers that exclude either file.

The three optionality guards (subprocess spawn test, AST walk test, and block_extra fixture eviction) do not rely on a polluted worker process, so they remain strong after deletion and no coverage loss occurs.
